iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE
       Triggered when a client-side SSL handshake is completed.

DESCRIPTION
       Triggered when a client-side SSL handshake is completed. If LTM requests a certificate from the client this event would be
       triggered after the CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT event.

Examples
	when CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE {
	    persist ssl
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
